name: certiflowapp
description: CertiFlow - Automated Subcontractor Insurance (COI) & Endorsement Compliance Portal

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}); for (const f of ['index.html', '_headers', 'favicon.svg', 'og-image.png']) { if (fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f); } console.log('Build complete: output in dist/');"
